scripts.test:unit: vitest run test/auth test/osv test/sbom test/smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: vitest run test/acceptance test/findings test/infra test/integration
scripts.test:isolated: find test -type f -name '*.test.ts' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -r -n 1 ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run
scripts.check:go: cd matcher && go mod tidy -diff && go mod verify && test -z "$(gofumpt -l .)" && golangci-lint run ./... && govulncheck ./... && go test -race -shuffle=on -count=1 ./...
scripts.check:infra: tofu -chdir=infra fmt -check -diff -recursive && tofu -chdir=infra init -backend=false -input=false -lockfile=readonly && tofu -chdir=infra validate -no-color && tofu -chdir=infra test && lock=$(mktemp) && trap 'rm -f "$lock"' EXIT && cp infra/.terraform.lock.hcl "$lock" && tofu -chdir=infra providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64 -platform=darwin_amd64 -platform=darwin_arm64 && cmp -s "$lock" infra/.terraform.lock.hcl && tflint --chdir=infra --force --no-color && trivy config --misconfig-scanners terraform --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 infra && terraform-docs markdown table --output-file README.md --output-mode inject --output-check infra
scripts.check: bun run check:types && bun run build:matcher && bun run build:admin && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run check:go && bun run test:isolated && bun run e2e && bun run check:infra
